then.htmlContent:
shout (Message) - Shout a message to everyone
$ (Amount) - Give yourself levels
clearzombies - Kill all units owned by the Zombie AI
+ (Amount) - Set the time based on the state. (Summoning, Battle)
tpall - Teleport everyone to your mouse position.
itemall - Give everyone an Item.
e-set (Entity)l - Select an entity to summon once the keybind 'P'is pressed. Type 'entity list' to see all entitys (ENTITY LIST DOES NOT EXIST YET)

message.textB: levels was added to your current level.
